actual_facts: Actual CLI module cmd/agentsecctl. main runCommand dispatches non-version to runReleaseCommand; no enrollment command currently. Profiles ValidateDeploymentProfile(customer_edge) validates supplied values only, not actual enrollment.

No enrollment route or client exists in bounded gatewaycontrol/gateway-control source. Original15 enrollment SQL is admitted to original zasp_gateway_control, not old revoked zasp_runtime_gateway discovery enrollment path.

Original15 enroll input locator16/secret32/audience runtime-gateway-enroll +credentialID/generation/keyID/Ed25519/publickey32/expiry. Scoped token authentication derives scope/device/enrollmentID; request digest includes exact credential/key/generation/expiry. Same enrollment exact replay is supported, conflicting intent denied; requested expiry must still be future and within90days.

Original15 enroll return has id,device_id,credential_generation,key_id,algorithm,audience,issued_at,expires_at,replayed. It omits org/work/env/enrollmentID/public_key; cannot alone satisfy strict CLI scope and public-key binding. Original credential-authority function returns scope+publickey.

Current80 wraps enrollment token auth with organization serialization and wallclock token expiry after waits. Final adapter freshness/confirm semantics still need explicit source design; transaction_timestamp enrollment argument checks do not alone prove current final expiry.

Current runtime credential file is exact canonical three-field JSON credential_id,key_id,private_key; private key canonical RawURL64bytes. Extra intent/state fields cannot be added to this file because runtime decoder rejects unknown fields and noncanonical bytes.

CLI cannot import platform/internal/cacheownership directly due Go internal package boundary: cmd/agentsecctl is outside services/platform parent. Public policy-independent custody facade inside platform can import internal helper and expose only the new custody operations. No policy/gatewaycontrol import needed by CLI, preventing OPA import closure.

proposed_contract.command: agentsecctl gateway-enroll --endpoint HTTPS_ORIGIN --ca-bundle-file ABS --custody-file ABS --credential-output ABS --timeout DURATION < closed-input.json; all arguments nonsecret; no env lookup, token argv, private stdout/stderr or echoing transport errors.
proposed_contract.input: Closed bounded stdin object holding expected org/work/env/device/enrollmentID, explicit stable credentialID and expected credential generation, keyID and explicit whole-UTC expiry, plus enrollment_locator canonicalRawURL16 and enrollment_secret canonicalRawURL32. No new token string prefix is invented. Secret-ref alternative is a named existing private file path read with existing owned-file controls, not a new SDK/provider integration.
proposed_contract.key_and_intent: Generate Ed25519 exactly once from crypto/rand after all input/path validation, before HTTP. One immutable0600 bounded private custody bundle holds schema, exact request bytes, expected scoped identity, endpoint origin, enrollment locator digest, canonical private64/public32 pair, stable credentialID/gen/keyID/expiry. Store no enrollment secret; retry rereads it from stdin/explicit private source and matches locator digest. Never regenerate key/credentialID/expiry on existing state, timeout or ambiguous response. Validate ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed)==private64/public before using existing custody.
proposed_contract.ownership: Public stdlib-only services/platform/gatewayenrollmentcustody facade can reuse platform/internal/cacheownership under pinned existing parent os.Root. Linux nonblocking stable sibling flock held from initial read/create through request/receipt persistence/export and close. Current UID regular0600 singlelink files, pre/open/post inode checks, no parent chmod/chown, no overwrite of differing existing bundle or runtime credential; unsupported platform selected custody refuses. Trusted parent/sameUID/cooperating binaries limits explicit.
proposed_contract.durability: For create-only immutable custody, write random sibling O_EXCL0600, fsync file, publish without replacing destination (Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE or rooted hardlink+unlink proven supported), fsync directory, exact readback before first network request. A plain replacing Rename is insufficient for no-overwrite. If implementation avoids unavailable root-relative no-replace primitive, create O_EXCL destination directly with fsync and treat every partial/unknown file as terminal custody error; never send or replace it. A recoverable implementation should choose/freeze publication semantics explicitly before product.
proposed_contract.receipt_and_export: New fixed HTTP enrollment adapter must return a bounded closed wrapper combining same-transaction original authentication identity, original15 enrollment result, and credential-authority publickey/scope under original gateway role; successful COMMIT before HTTP200. CLI validates all expected scope/device/enrollment/credential/gen/key/algorithm/audience/publickey/expiry/request hash. After acceptance persist immutable receipt (separate create-only file or same-key atomic state successor design), then export exact runtime-compatible three-field credential JSON without overwrite; exact existing output replay may succeed after revalidation. Never print private key or enrollment token.
proposed_contract.ambiguous: Any timeout/cancel/COMMIT-unknown/truncated receipt/receipt-export failure retains original private custody and exact intent for retry. At credential/token expiry, revocation, conflicting receipt or changed expected input, fail closed and report unresolved state; do not mint replacement or infer never committed. Expired replay is not promised by original15.
proposed_contract.report: Only bounded nonsecret status enum and stable credentialID/expected scope if desired; no raw response, endpoint errors, secret paths, public/private key or request payload reflection. No launch/enforcement/coverage success claim.

existing_reuse.use: Preserve exit1/no secret exception printing; route new command in runReleaseCommand.
Reuse dispatch and JSON writer; add smaller closed exact-key parser for secrets because decodeCommandInput returns raw errors and permits ordinary typed JSON case aliases.
Reuse owned private/CA file and TLS/HTTPS-origin/no-redirect/direct-dial pattern. Do not instantiate RecoveryClient requiring PAT or reuse Bearer PAT authentication.
Reuse through a new public platform custody facade; do not copy policy cache or import gatewaycontrol/policy into CLI.
Exact output wire compatibility target only; package main cannot be imported.

grouped_acceptance: Before-send custody durable/readback and key/public pair exact; invalidinput/unsafeexisting/ownercontention/partialfile/fsyncfailure zeroHTTP and no overwritten key.
Actual TLS enrollment request exact persisted body; lostresponse/restart samecredentialID/gen/key/expiry; changed input or foreign pubkey/scope/receipt refuses, keeps intent.
Accepted receipt persists then exact runtime-compatible credential export; conflict/outputfailure preserves accepted state and safe retry; no token/key leakage in output/errors/argv/env.
Current original enrollment sameTX commit/lateexpiry/revoke/rotation/currentprofile controls belong connected backend/native integration, not pure CLI fixture completion.
